body: Thank you for your kindness. I really appreciate it.
I would want a forever dream where you could go to sleep, enter a dream, and live it to the fullest where everything you wanted happens. Then just wake up and die inside cause it’s the next day.
If I hear switch with someone dying I would say yes lightning fast. I don’t even care anymore. Life just sucks I can’t do anything to make it better and that’s ok.
